title: Let's Learn English Lesson 21
subtitle: Can You Come to the Party?
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 21: Can You Come to the Party? (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi there! Washington, D.C. has some great coffee shops. My favorite is this one -- Busboys & Poets.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！华盛顿特区有一些很棒的咖啡店。我最喜欢的就是这一家——Busboys & Poets。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Actually it's more than a coffee shop. It's also a bookstore, a restaurant and a theater!
dialogue.zh: 其实它不只是咖啡店。它还是书店、餐厅，还有剧院！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha and I love coming here.
dialogue.zh: 玛莎和我都喜欢来这儿。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Hey, Anna, my friend is having a party on Saturday. Can you come with me?
dialogue.zh: 嘿，安娜，我朋友星期六要办派对。你能和我一起去吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sorry, I can't come with you. I have to get my driver's license.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我不能和你去。我得去考驾照。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Will you be busy all day?
dialogue.zh: 你会忙一整天吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I don't know. First, I have to take a test on the computer. Then I have to take a test in the car.
dialogue.zh: 我不知道。先要考电脑上的笔试。然后还要考路上的路考。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: But you have to take the test during the day, don't you?
dialogue.zh: 可你得在白天考试，对吧？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.zh: 对。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: The party is at night.
dialogue.zh: 派对是在晚上。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh. Then I can come with you to the party on Saturday night.
dialogue.zh: 哦。那我星期六晚上可以和你去派对。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Great! I have to help my friend with the party. Can you help me?
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我得帮朋友筹备派对。你能帮我吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sure. That sounds like fun.
dialogue.zh: 当然。听起来很好玩。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Everyone has to bring something or do something. You can bring food, or you can perform.
dialogue.zh: 每个人都得带点东西或者做点什么。你可以带食物，也可以表演。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Really, I can perform?
dialogue.zh: 真的吗，我可以表演？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: You can! Can you?
dialogue.zh: 可以！你行吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes! I can recite poetry.
dialogue.zh: 可以！我会朗诵诗。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: In this country, nobody recites poetry at parties. Um … can you do anything else?
dialogue.zh: 在这个国家，没人在派对上朗诵诗。嗯……你还会别的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hmm, yes. I can do a card trick.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，会。我会纸牌魔术。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, maybe you can just bring food.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，也许你还是带食物吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, I can't cook. And I really want to perform. You know, there is one thing I can do.
dialogue.zh: 不行，我不会做饭。而且我真的想表演。你知道，有一件事我会。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Trouble in mind. I'm blue...
dialogue.zh: 心里有烦恼。我很忧郁……

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: That's it! You can sing at the party. Now, I have to go shopping for food.
dialogue.zh: 就是这个！你可以在派对上唱歌。现在我得去买食物了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Can I help? I'm not busy right now.
dialogue.zh: 我能帮忙吗？我现在不忙。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Sure, let's go!
dialogue.zh: 当然，走吧！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We have to go. I have to help Marsha shop. And I have to practice my song!
dialogue.zh: 我们得走了。我要帮玛莎买东西。我还得练习我的歌！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time!
dialogue.zh: 下次见！

quiz.prompt: Why can't Anna go to the party at first?
choices: She has to get her driver's license
She has to work all day

quiz.prompt: What does Marsha say Anna can do at the party?
